title: 第94章 文采我没有，我只会杀人！

content_zh: 唐画恨唐逸不死，恨不得将他千刀万剐。　　只是在唐敬面前，他还是努力维持好大哥的形象。　　当即抬手敲了敲唐浩的额头，道：“胡说八道，小逸是我们兄弟，兄弟之间就算有意见，关起门来解决就是。”　　“在外面胡闹，不是让人看笑话吗？这种事以后别再提。”　　唐敬看着懂事的大儿子，又想到处处忤逆他的唐逸，脸色不由沉了几分。　　更何况这两日，他原本想要借姜云娜的手，趁机将唐逸控制住，免得他出去给唐画使绊子，丢人现眼。　　结果，他直接躲进燕王府，两天都不回家，简直可恶！　　“浩儿说得对，对唐逸没有必要处处忍让，你作为大哥，该教训还是得教训。”　　唐敬看着唐画，语气冷漠道：“他今日敢和你作对，就给我好好收拾他！”　　颜霜玉等的就是唐敬这话，看着唐画道：“画儿，你爹说得对，这次无论如何都得让小逸吃点苦头。”　　“这是为了帮助他，这孩子这段时间太胡闹了，再让他胡闹下去非得出事不可。”　　颜霜玉脸上带着笑容，心头却恨得牙痒痒。　　唐逸害她被宫里那女人打了一巴掌，让她在京都那些贵族女人丢尽脸面。　　这个仇，不死不休！　　“对啊，画哥哥，他都那么对你了，你还和他客气什么？”姜云娜走上前，抱住唐画的手臂，撒娇。　　她要让自己喜欢的男人，将唐逸踩进尘埃。　　林竹虽然没有说话，但双眼充满怨毒，已经说明了她的态度。　　唐画听完他们的话，只得装得一脸无奈道：“好吧，那便按你们说的办吧！”　　这时，颜霜玉看向林竹，道：“林竹，沈园诗会你就别去了，庆功宴的事京都很多人对你都有意见，你出现怕会影响到画儿。”　　听到这话，林竹脸色顿时苍白下来，她还想趁着这机会洗刷耻辱，现在不让她参加了？　　唐敬也不想一个恶名昭彰的恶妇和唐家人站在一起，也看向林竹平静道：“竹儿，我们都去参加沈园诗会，家里也需要人照应，你便留在家里照应下吧！”　　林竹咬着唇，看向唐浩，想要唐浩帮着说说情。　　唐浩哪里敢忤逆唐敬和颜霜玉，当即一挥衣袖道：“看我干什么？父亲和母亲怎么说，你就怎么做就是了。”　　连丈夫都这么说了，林竹只能敛衽行礼：“是，儿媳知道了，儿媳留在家里。”　　唐敬点点头，从位置上站了起来往外走。　　“走吧，时间也差不多了，该去沈园了。”　　颜霜玉，唐画几人立即跟上，只留下林竹一个人孤零零站在院中。　　看着唐家一家人渐渐远去的背影，林竹的脸色越来越冷，眼底深处泛起了浓浓的恨意。　　该死的，我为唐家尽心竭力，你们竟然就这样对我？　　与此同时，唐家西院。　　杜凌菲也已经将唐音打扮得漂漂亮亮的，刮了刮唐音的鼻子道：“哇，这是谁家的小姑娘，居然这么漂亮？”　　唐音大眼睛眨了眨，道：“嗯，我哥哥家的。”　　说完，她抬头看向杜凌菲，纠结了一下道：“杜姐姐，你做我嫂嫂好不好？”　　噗！　　杜凌菲正在喝水，一口水直接喷了出去。　　她性格素来安静，这时候脸颊上也泛起两抹红晕：“呸，小鬼头，你胡说什么呢！”　　唐音学着唐逸的样子抬手摸着下巴沉思：“可是姐姐你脸红了呀，姐姐不想成为我嫂子脸怎么会红呢？”　　“而且，姐姐是除了娘和哥哥外，对音音最好的人了。”　　“哥哥说，只有最爱你的人，才会无条件对你好。”　　唐音笑了起来：“姐姐对我和哥哥那么好，那一定是最爱我们的人。”　　杜凌菲本来还有些羞涩，这越听越不对味了，怎么说得我像是你娘一样？　　“下来，咱们该去参加沈园诗会了，今天诗会有很多好吃的。”　　杜凌菲直接将唐音抱下梳妆台，强行转移话题，不想在这话题上和唐音争论。　　否则传到唐逸的耳中，可咋整？　　果然，听到有很多好吃的，唐音大眼睛瞬间亮了起来，当场就将这事给忘记了。　　皇宫，御书房。　　炎文帝伸了一个懒腰，看向天边已经升起的太阳，眯着眼睛问道：“老东西，准备得怎么样了？”　　抱着拂尘的陈貂寺立即低眉顺眼道：“回陛下，一切准备就绪。”　　炎文帝扭了扭脖子，有些郁闷道：“有时候吧，朕很想借暗京楼的手，清洗一下那群老匹夫，让朝堂重新洗牌。”　　“可是，在京都让一群地沟里的老鼠，杀得朝中大臣血流成河，朕又丢不起那人。”　　“想想，朕都觉得憋屈，他们处处和朕作对，恨朕不死，朕还得想方设法尽量保全他们……”　　陈貂寺笑着拱手道：“陛下雄才伟略，自然不屑于这些低级的手段，而且，老奴知道陛下是不想给那些江湖人开个坏头。”　　“否则，将来江湖中人将随意取朝中官员脑袋，那整个国家都会乱套的。”　　炎文帝脸上的情绪渐渐收敛，脸上有冷意：“是啊！那些大臣，只要他们触犯大炎律法，朕能杀他们。”　　“但江湖人，谁都不能碰他们！”　　炎文帝看向陈貂寺，道：“去备车吧，咱们也该出发了。”　　“好戏登场，接下来，就看谁的技术……更高一筹了！”　　……　　大炎京都，北狄使馆中。　　北狄三皇子宇文封正在院中练箭。　　数十步外的箭靶，已经插满了箭羽。　　“三王子，今日便是大炎的沈园诗会，我们要参加吗？”　　身后，穿着黑衣的北狄使臣述里虎手贴在胸前，弯腰恭敬说道。　　“去，为何不去？”　　宇文封冷笑一声，道：“不过大炎那些酸溜溜文采我不会，我只会杀人。”　　“而且，既然父王帮暗京楼铺好了台，那这场大戏，我岂能错过。”　　“再者，本王也想会会那个给皇帝出谋划策的小诗仙，敢坏我北狄的南侵大计，他就该死。”　　话落，宇文封手一松，弓上箭羽呼啸而出，正中靶心。　　如果不是因为那什么劳什子的小诗仙，给皇帝出的乱七八糟的计策，导致北狄和东虞联军貌合神离，现在北狄大军恐怕早就兵临城下了。　　而他，也该站在城墙上，将整座城踏在脚下，让整座城在他的脚下臣服。
content_en: Tang Hua hated Tang Yi and wanted to kill him with a thousand knives.But in front of Tang Jing, he still tried hard to maintain the image of a good elder brother.He immediately raised his hand and knocked on Tang Hao's forehead, saying: "Nonsense, Xiaoyi is our brother. Even if there are differences between brothers, they can be solved behind closed doors." "Isn't it a joke to make people laugh when you are messing around outside? Don't mention this kind of thing again." Tang Jing looked at his sensible eldest son, and Tang Yi, who wanted to disobey him everywhere, couldn't help but look a little darker.What's more, in the past two days, he originally wanted to use Jiang Yunna's hand to control Tang Yi, so that he would not go out to cause trouble for Tang Hua and embarrass himself.As a result, he hid directly in Prince Yan's Mansion and didn't go home for two days. It was simply abominable!"Haoer is right. There is no need to be patient with Tang Yi. As the eldest brother, you still have to teach him a lesson." Tang Jing looked at Tang Hua and said in a cold tone: "If he dares to go against you today, just deal with him!" Yan Shuangyu was waiting for Tang Jing's words and looked at Tang Jing.Hua said: "Hua'er, your father is right, Xiaoyi must suffer a little this time no matter what." "This is to help him. This child has been too naughty these days. If he continues to act like crazy, something will happen." Yan Shuangyu had a smile on her face, but her heart was itching with hatred.Tang Yi caused her to be slapped by the woman in the palace, making her lose face among the noble women in Kyoto.This hatred will never end!"Yes, Brother Hua, he has treated you like this, why are you being polite to him?" Jiang Yunna stepped forward, hugged Tang Hua's arm, and acted coquettishly.She wants the man she likes to trample Tang Yi into the dust.Although Lin Zhu didn't speak, her eyes were full of hatred, which already explained her attitude.After hearing what they said, Tang Hua could only pretend to be helpless and said, "Okay, then I'll do as you say!" At this time, Yan Shuangyu looked at Lin Zhu and said, "Lin Zhu, don't go to the Shenyuan Poetry Recital. Let's celebrate."Many people in Kyoto have objections to you about the banquet.I'm afraid your presence will affect Hua'er." Hearing this, Lin Zhu's face suddenly turned pale. She still wanted to take this opportunity to wash away her shame. Now she is not allowed to participate?Tang Jing didn't want a notorious evil woman to stand with the Tang family. He also looked at Lin Zhu and said calmly: "Zhu'er, we are all going to attend the Shen Yuan Poetry Recital. We also need someone to take care of our family, so you can stay at home and take care of us!" Lin Zhu bit her lip and looked at Tang Hao, hoping for Tang Hao's help in interceding.How could Tang Hao dare to disobey Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu? He immediately waved his sleeves and said, "Look what I'm going to do? Just do whatever your father and mother say." Even her husband said so. Lin Zhu could only draw her sleeves and salute: "Yes, my daughter-in-law knows. My daughter-in-law stays at home." Tang Jing nodded, stood up from his position and walked out."Let's go, it's almost time. It's time to go to Shen Garden." Yan Shuangyu, Tang Hua and the others immediately followed, leaving Lin Zhu standing alone in the courtyard.Looking at the Tang family's retreating figures, Lin Zhu's face became colder and colder, and there was deep hatred in his eyes.Damn it, I have worked hard for the Tang family, and you are treating me like this?At the same time, in the west courtyard of the Tang family.Du Lingfei had also dressed Tang Yin up beautifully. She scratched Tang Yin's nose and said, "Wow, whose little girl is this, so beautiful?" Tang Yin blinked her big eyes and said, "Well, she is from my brother's family." After saying that, she looked up at Du Lingfei, hesitated and said, "Sister Du, can you be my sister-in-law?" Poof!Du Lingfei was drinking water and squirted out a mouthful of water.She has always had a quiet personality, and at this time there were two blushes on her cheeks: "Bah, little ghost head, what are you talking nonsense!" Tang Yin imitated Tang Yi and raised his hand to touch his chin and pondered: "But sister, you are blushing. How can sister be blushing if she doesn't want to be my sister-in-law?" "Besides, besides mother and brother, sister is"My brother said that only the person who loves you the most will be kind to you unconditionally."Tang Yin laughed: "Sister is so kind to me and my brother, she must be the person who loves us the most."Du Lingfei was a little shy at first, but the more she heard this, the more uncomfortable she became. Why did she make me sound like your mother?"Come down, we should go to the Shen Yuan Poetry Club. There will be a lot of delicious food at the Poetry Club today." Du Lingfei directly carried Tang Yin off the dressing table and forcibly changed the topic, not wanting to argue with Tang Yin on this topic.Otherwise, what can be done if it reaches Tang Yi's ears?Sure enough, when Tang Yin heard that there were a lot of delicious food, his big eyes lit up instantly, and he forgot about it on the spot.Imperial Palace, Imperial Study Room.Emperor Yanwen stretched out, looked at the sun that had risen in the sky, squinted his eyes and asked, "Old man, how are you preparing?" Chen Diaosi, who was holding the fly whisk, immediately lowered his eyebrows and said, "Your Majesty, everything is ready." Emperor Yanwen twisted his neck and said a little depressed: "Sometimes, I would like to borrow An Jinglou's hand.Clean up those old men and let the court reshuffle." "But I can't afford to let a group of rats in the ditch kill the ministers in Kyoto and make them bleed like rivers." "I feel aggrieved when I think about it.They oppose me everywhere and hate me to death. I have to find ways to protect them as much as possible..." Chen Diaosi smiled and handed over.He said: "Your Majesty is so talented and powerful that he naturally disdains these low-level methods. Moreover, I know that your Majesty does not want to give those people in the world a bad start." "Otherwise, in the future, people in the world will take the heads of officials in the court at will, and the whole country will be in chaos." The emotions on Emperor Yanwen's face gradually subsided, and there was a cold look on his face: "Yes! Those peopleMinister, as long as they violate the laws of Dayan, I can kill them." "But no one can touch them!" Emperor Yan Wen looked at Chen Diao Temple and said, "Let's prepare the car.It's time for us to set off." "The show is about to begin.Let's see who has better skills..."... In the Beidi Embassy in Dayan Kyoto.Yu Wenfeng, the third prince of Beidi, was practicing archery in the courtyard.The archery target dozens of steps away was already filled with arrow feathers."Third Prince, today is Dayan's Shen Yuan Poetry Recital. Do we want to participate?" Behind him, Beidi envoy Shuli Hu, dressed in black, put his hands on his chest.
title_en: Chapter 94 I don’t have any literary talent, I can only kill people!
